title: ついに集まったチームメンバー！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've finally gathered enough members to form a team, and we can now enter the Unity Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our training level will go up based on our team ranking in the Unity Cup, so I'm hoping to win as many races as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first, I need to decide on a team name. I can choose between the names the others suggested and the one I came up with, Team Carrot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fill in our name on the form as "Happy Hoppers." That makes it official!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fill in our name on the form as "Sunny Runners." That makes it official!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fill in our name on the form as "Carrot Pudding." That makes it official!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fill in our name on the form as "Blue Bloom." That makes it official!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fill in our name on the form as "Team Carrot." That makes it official!
